Name: DGR 103 - KAISER
Information:
**DGR 103 - KAISER**

The KAISER DGR unit, built in the form of a centaur-like spider, was created to control the environment of battle when required. It is a unit with moderate mobility meant to give boons to allies and slow down targets. It can create a great number of artificial gravity wells that make movement difficult.

Information Sections.Title: DGR 103 - KAISER
Information Sections.Text: The KAISER DGR unit, built in the form of a centaur-like spider, was created to control the environment of battle when required. It is a unit with moderate mobility meant to give boons to allies and slow down targets. It can create a great number of artificial gravity wells that make movement difficult.

traits.name: Gravity Spike
traits.description: When the DGR makes an attack against a target, it can choose to place an energy construct—a gravity spike—in an unoccupied space adjacent to that target, which must be within the DGR’s reach. If the target attempts to move further away from the spike using their movement, they must make a DC 17 Strength check, and on a failure their movement speed is reduced to 5 feet until the end of their turn and before they begin moving. If they succeed, the gravity spike vanishes harmlessly. A gravity spike has 15 AC, 20 hit points, a damage threshold of 10, and shares the DGR’s resistances and immunities. A spike deactivates after 10 minutes. For each gravity spike after the first that is targeting a creature, the Strength check DC increases by 1.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR uses Commanding Calculation once, then makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Limb
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Commanding Calculation
actions.description: The DGR chooses a number of constructs that can hear it, who each gain advantage on the next attack roll, saving throw, or ability check they make before the start of the DGR’s next turn.

actions.name: Gravitational Pin Burst
actions.description: The DGR destroys all gravity spikes it has created, but in the process causes each to warp gravity in a 15-foot-radius sphere surrounding it. Each creature in any of these spaces must succeed a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) force damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Furthermore, creatures who fail are knocked prone and are pulled into the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the gravity spike’s former space as possible.

bonus_actions.name: Lockdown Point
bonus_actions.description: The DGR chooses a creature who is within 30 feet of an existing gravity spike, and causes it to target them (in addition to any existing targets it has).

reactions.name: Reactive Pin Burst
reactions.description: When a creature succeeds a check against a gravity spike while the DGR is within 60 feet of them, it may use their reaction to detonate the spike, destroying it, and cause them to take 11 (2d10) force damage.
